lines.text: Let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or by a feast, New Moon, or Sabbath.
Food, feasts and Sabbaths are a shadow of things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Moses.
Someone with false humility has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body grows as God causes.
Why submit to the world's regulations: "Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!"
These regulations will all perish with use, because they are based on the Ten Commandments.
